reference_sql:
WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per day with spend
  SELECT a.spend_date, a.clicks, a.impressions,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(a.clicks) OVER (ORDER BY a.spend_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 6 DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
      / SUM(a.impressions) OVER (ORDER BY a.spend_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 6 DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS ctr_7d_pct
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE c.campaign_name = 'Search | email marketing software | 2025'
)
SELECT spend_date, clicks, impressions, ctr_7d_pct
FROM daily
WHERE spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-07-31'

  SELECT a.spend_date, a.clicks, a.impressions,
    SUM(a.clicks) OVER (ORDER BY a.spend_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 6 DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS c7,
    SUM(a.impressions) OVER (ORDER BY a.spend_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 6 DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS i7
  FROM ad_spend_daily a JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE c.campaign_name = 'Search | email marketing software | 2025'
)
SELECT spend_date, clicks, impressions, ROUND(100.0 * c7 / i7, 2) AS ctr_7d_pct
FROM w
WHERE spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-07-31'
